transcript: W1: Victor, Hannah, thanks for joining me. The buyers from Brenridge Foods have confirmed they'll visit next week, and they mainly want to see our new packaging line in action.
M: That's great, but the line will be shut down on Monday and Tuesday for its first scheduled maintenance.
W1: Then how about Friday? That would give us a few extra days to prepare.
W2: That day won't work. The painters have the whole production floor booked, and visitors aren't allowed in while they're working.
M: Wednesday or Thursday, then. I'd go with Thursday. The maintenance crew sometimes runs a day over.
W1: Thursday it is. I'll let the buyers know this afternoon. Hannah, can you take care of the safety gear?
W2: Sure. We'll need helmets and glasses for the visitors, and our spare sets are pretty worn out.
W1: Then order new ones today. The supplier usually takes three days to deliver.
W2: Will do. I'll call them as soon as we're done here.
